Wholesale Electric Salt and Pepper Grinders

Battery and USB rechargeable grinders, gravity models, and 2-pack sets with bases — for retail and gift programmes.

Request salt & pepper grinders pricing Custom logo options

About this range

Electric grinders are the highest-value kitchen electric in the catalogue and one of the easiest to sell as a two-pack gift. This range includes classic push-button models, gravity-activated grinders that mill one-handed, USB rechargeable units, and matched two-pack sets with wooden or charging bases. A clear feature set — adjustable ceramic or stainless burr, visible fill window, washable grinder body — is what lets a retailer sell these without a salesperson.

ABS, PMMA, acrylic, stainless steel

Salt &amp; Pepper Grinders — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Salt & Pepper Grinders range include?

This range holds 19 items, specified in ABS, PMMA, acrylic and stainless steel. Orders come most often from kitchenware retailers, gift and corporate programmes and retail and e-commerce brands. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

Which salt & pepper grinders models can I order for wholesale?

This range covers the models listed on the product cards. Each SKU page states the specification, the set contents and the customization route, because battery type, plug standard, certification and packaging all change the price.

Rechargeable electrics range

What is the MOQ for a salt & pepper grinders model?

MOQ is maintained by SKU/model and by configuration, not by the category. A single unit set and a multi-piece set have different minimums. Check the selected product page or send the SKU and quantity for a model-specific quotation.

How MOQ works

What is the FOB dispatch time for these electric products?

For no-stock electric wine openers, milk frothers, pepper grinders, coffee machines and related electrical products, FOB dispatch normally takes 45–60 working days. FOB dispatch timing is confirmed against the selected SKU, approved artwork, packaging configuration, quantity and agreed order route; destination-specific freight arrival is quoted separately.

Request a quote

What certification is available for the electrics?

Certification documentation is confirmed per model and provided with the quotation. Tell us the destination market so we confirm which certification applies to the SKU you select.

About the factory

How should battery-powered products be shipped?

Battery-powered products ship with the transport documentation required for the agreed route. The shipping method is confirmed at quotation because it depends on the battery configuration and the destination.

Wholesale programme

Can I order a sample first?

Sample availability and cost are confirmed for the selected SKU and customization route. Include the SKU, artwork, packaging requirement and destination when requesting a sample.
